svg.text: All subsystems. Solid diamond = composition (owns). Open diamond = aggregation (references). Triangle = inheritance. Arrow = uses / drives.
GameManager owns / updates every subsystem manager (dashed)

g.text: Composition — owner creates & destroys the part (Player ◆ AbilityManager)
Aggregation — references parts it does not own (Inventory ◇ Item)
Inheritance — subclass extends abstract base (DoubleJump ▷ Ability)
Association — one class uses or drives another (Puzzle → Interactable)
Manager wiring — GameManager updates each subsystem via the EventBus
«Name» in italics = abstract base class. $ = static/singleton. ▸ = subclasses listed inline to save space.
